original_text:
🔥 Real Projects.✅Clean Resume.⛔Still Rejected in PySpark Round. - NTTDATA Data Engineer position 
-----------------------------------------
One of my friend recently appeared for a Data Engineering interview at NTT DATA.
Despite 4+ years of experience…
❌ He was rejected in the PySpark technical round.

💥 Why?
🚩Because NTT DATA didn’t ask about .show() or basic APIs.
They tested real-world PySpark performance, logic, and debugging.

💣 PySpark Questions Asked in NTT DATA Interview:
🧠 Spark Internals & Execution
🔸 Explain the full lifecycle of a Spark job — from code to DAG to task execution.
🔸 What is the difference between transformations and actions? Why are transformations lazy?
🔸 What happens under the hood when you call .collect() on a huge dataset?

🧮 Memory & Partition Tuning
🔸 How do you identify and fix data skew in PySpark joins?
🔸 What is the impact of incorrect partitioning on performance?
🔸 When would you increase spark.sql.shuffle.partitions, and what are the risks?
🔸 What is the role of broadcast joins? When should you avoid them?

🔄 Window Functions & Complex ETL
🔸 Use a PySpark window function to get the top 3 orders per customer.
🔸 How would you implement SCD Type 2 with Delta Lake + PySpark?
🔸 How do you remove duplicates from a dataset based on composite keys?

💾 Delta Lake + Merge Logic
🔸 What happens if two users try to merge into the same Delta table at the same time?
🔸 How do you perform an upsert using PySpark on a Delta table?
🔸 How do you handle schema evolution in Delta tables programmatically?

🌊 Structured Streaming + Watermarking
🔸 Explain exactly-once semantics in Spark Structured Streaming.
🔸 Late data is arriving after the window closes — how do you handle it with watermarks?
🔸 How would you join a real-time stream with a dimension table in PySpark?

🧪 Debugging + Monitoring + Failure Handling
🔸 Your Spark job ran successfully but processed 0 records — how do you debug that?
🔸 Explain speculative execution in Spark — when and how do you enable it?
🔸 How do you use Spark UI to find slow stages or skewed tasks?

🔐 Security, CI/CD, and Production Readiness
🔸 How do you manage secrets securely in a PySpark job running in Databricks or EMR?
🔸 Describe your CI/CD pipeline for PySpark using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
🔸 How do you handle cluster resource allocation (executors, memory) for large jobs?

Follow Arabinda Pani for more posts
…see more
